# BoxFab Code Interpreter

> [!NOTE]
> The `@boxfab/code-interpreter` and `boxfab-code-interpreter` SDK sources live in
> [boxfab/js-sdk](https://github.com/boxfab/js-sdk/tree/main/code-interpreter) and
> [boxfab/python-sdk](https://github.com/boxfab/python-sdk/tree/main/code-interpreter). This
> repository keeps the sandbox template, which bundles the chart data extractor
> (`template/charts`).

## What is BoxFab?
[BoxFab](https://boxfab.io) runs AI-generated code in secure isolated sandboxes in the cloud. To
start and control sandboxes, use the [JavaScript SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@boxfab/code-interpreter)
or the [Python SDK](https://pypi.org/project/boxfab-code-interpreter/).

## Run your first Sandbox

### 1. Install SDK

JavaScript / TypeScript
```
npm i @boxfab/code-interpreter
```

Python
```
pip install boxfab-code-interpreter
```

### 2. Get your BoxFab API key
1. Get your API key in the [BoxFab dashboard](https://dashboard.boxfab.io).
2. Set environment variable with your API key.
```
BOXFAB_API_KEY=e2b_***
```

### 3. Execute code with code interpreter inside Sandbox

JavaScript / TypeScript
```ts
import { Sandbox } from '@boxfab/code-interpreter'

const sbx = await Sandbox.create()
await sbx.runCode('x = 1')

const execution = await sbx.runCode('x+=1; x')
console.log(execution.text)  // outputs 2
```

Python
```py
from boxfab_code_interpreter import Sandbox

with Sandbox.create() as sandbox:
    sandbox.run_code("x = 1")
    execution = sandbox.run_code("x+=1; x")
    print(execution.text)  # outputs 2
```

## Customizing the sandbox template
Need extra packages or a different runtime? You can build your own Code Interpreter sandbox template. See the [template guide](/template/README.md) for a step-by-step walkthrough of creating, building, and using a custom template (as well as building the production `code-interpreter-v1` template).

## Under the hood

BoxFab sandboxes are [Firecracker](https://firecracker-microvm.github.io/) microVMs, run on the
open-source [E2B](https://github.com/e2b-dev/infra) sandbox infrastructure. This repository is
derived from the open-source [E2B Code Interpreter](https://github.com/e2b-dev/code-interpreter)
repository; the template is generated from it by `scripts/sync_upstream.py` and built with the
BoxFab SDK. [UPSTREAM.md](UPSTREAM.md) lists every change.

**Using the E2B Code Interpreter SDKs.** BoxFab serves the same API and provides the
`code-interpreter-v1` template, so the E2B Code Interpreter SDKs work with it as well. Set both
variables, the domain first:

```bash
export E2B_DOMAIN=boxfab.io
export E2B_API_KEY="<your BoxFab API key>"
```

Without `E2B_DOMAIN`, the E2B SDKs send requests, including the key, to E2B's own service.

Tested against BoxFab with `e2b-code-interpreter` 2.11.6 (Python) and `@e2b/code-interpreter` 2.9.0
(JavaScript).
